sequential_dependency.intermediate: The input-derived per-cell king-distance depth maps together with the ordered palette recovered at those depths.
sequential_dependency.step_a: Partition nonwall cells into regions, repeatedly erode each region with all eight neighbors, and recover each region-local cue palette by true inward depth.
sequential_dependency.step_b: Use each retained depth and palette to choose the cyclic or bouncing color index and repaint every region cell while preserving walls.
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: A bounding-box or four-neighbor depth cannot supply the same layer index in concave regions. The final painter consumes the exact depth map; substituting cardinal depth changes both recovered depth cues and painted bands.

parametric_work.summary: Reviewer-ready cyclic/bouncing inward-band family with 2–6 demonstrations and four privately sequenced queries, substantive 30×30 coverage, 29/29 source-bound tests, protected parent-label preflight, 4,608 declared-rival comparisons, and a replayed 45-cell cardinal-depth counterfactual.
